title: 600-update bounded resident co-adaptation after full newcomer communication reset
question: 当陌生主体的发送端和接收端都被重置时，居民端的有限、稀疏共同适应是否改变恢复速度、最终功能和既有协议的稳定性？
hypotheses: 冻结居民提供一个只有陌生主体适应的基线；允许居民稀疏更新将提高早期恢复，但可能牺牲既有协议稳定性。
居民 receiver 稀疏更新与居民 sender 稀疏更新的收益不同，差异取决于形成期的角色随机化。
居民双侧稀疏更新的端点收益若超过单侧更新，并伴随可测的居民通信漂移，则说明恢复来自共同重构而非单个新主体的单向拟合。

resident_update_rule.bound: At most 30 resident optimizer steps per chain; all other resident parameters, visual frontends and memory remain frozen.

secondary_metrics: resident communication drift relative to the resident endpoint
interpretation_boundary: This is a bounded co-adaptation experiment inside a finite grounded protocol. It tests whether limited resident plasticity changes recovery; it does not by itself test open-ended language, natural-language syntax, delayed survival, or generational transmission.

randomization.paired_unit: same seed × visual partition × resource assignment × resident culture

next_after_batch: Use the bounded-adaptation result to select a resident plasticity regime, then add delayed resource consequences and generational transmission.
